response.sql: WITH channel_counts AS (SELECT o.orderbase AS channel, AVG(e.fillcount) AS avg_filled_quantity, COUNT(DISTINCT o.orderspivot) AS order_count FROM orderexecutions AS e JOIN orders AS o ON e.ordersmark = o.recordvault GROUP BY o.orderbase) SELECT channel, avg_filled_quantity, order_count, 1.0 * order_count / SUM(order_count) OVER () AS order_fraction FROM channel_counts
